data.title: The Ultimate Astrology Course: Foundations to Chart Mastery
data.titleHi: ज्योतिष क्या है — वैदिक ज्योतिष की आधारशिला
data.shortDescription: Learn the sacred science of Vedic Astrology from first principles to real chart readings — completely self-paced with lifetime access.
data.shortDescriptionHi: 23 सुव्यवस्थित वीडियो मॉड्यूल, 2 व्यावहारिक कुंडली कार्यशालाओं और प्रामाणिक प्रमाणपत्र के साथ प्रामाणिक वैदिक ज्योतिष सीखें।
data.description: A comprehensive curriculum covering the nature of planets, 12 signs, 12 houses, planetary dignities, combustion, retrograde motion, dashas, nakshatras, gemstones, rudraksha, and practical chart interpretation with real case studies and personal 1-on-1 mentorship.
data.descriptionHi: आचार्य नीरज कुमार द्वारा निर्देशित शास्त्रीय पाराशरी ज्योतिष का आधारभूत मास्टरक्लास। 23 संरचित वीडियो व्याख्यानों, अध्ययन नोट्स, और व्यावहारिक कुंडली विश्लेषण के माध्यम से वैदिक ज्योतिष के मूल सिद्धांतों में महारत हासिल करें।

syllabusJson.title: What is Astrology? (nature of 9 planets, twelve houses and attributes, twelve Rashis and their lords)
keyTopics: Nature of 9 planets
Twelve Houses and their attributes
Twelve Rashis and their Lords
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover astrology. Astrology is the study of the positions of the planets and stars at the time of a person's birth that have an influence on their personality and destiny. Astrology is also connected with astronomy. It is related to speed movement. In this session, you will learn how planets act in human life. Astrologers believe that the planets have different influences on our lives. For example, Jupiter is associated with luck and opportunity, while Saturn is associated with discipline and responsibility. Covers the nature of 9 planets, twelve houses and their attributes, and twelve Rashis and their lords.

syllabusJson.title: How 9 Companions Work in Astrology?
keyTopics: The 9 Grahas and their cosmic roles
Placement traits and planetary conjunctions
Interplay of Grahas, Rashis, Nakshatras & Bhavas
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover how 9 companions work in astrology. Each of these 9 planets in astrology has certain traits that they infuse into the person. The intensity of giving out these traits changes with respect to their placement in the kundli or their conjunction with other planets. Entire astrology is based primarily on nine planets, twelve signs, twenty-seven Nakshatras, and twelve houses.

syllabusJson.title: Zodiac Signs and Their Importance
keyTopics: The 12 Rashis (Aries to Pisces)
Elemental classifications (Fire, Earth, Air, Water)
Modalities and governing planetary rulers
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will learn twelve zodiac signs that play a major role in our lives. Each zodiac sign is governed by their planet and in this way, the planet brings its characteristics to the sign.

syllabusJson.title: Kundli and Their Houses
keyTopics: Anatomy of the Vedic Kundali chart
House rulerships and moving transits
How house aspects alter over a lifetime
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover astrology has much more to contribute when it comes to learning how to read a kundli. Each of these houses is ruled by a zodiac sign. Also, planets in astrology move from one house to another throughout a person's life thus altering the aspect of that house from time to time.

syllabusJson.title: 12 Houses and Their Meaning in Human Life
keyTopics: The 12 Bhavas mapped to human existence
Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha houses
Self, wealth, siblings, home, children, health, marriage, longevity, destiny, career, gains, liberation
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will learn about houses in a birth chart that reveal key aspects of a person's life. The first - represents who you are, the second - possessions; the third - is communication, and many more houses you will learn in this session. Astrologers use planets in these houses to offer insights into a person's journey and self-discovery.

syllabusJson.title: Zodiac Sign and Their Lord
keyTopics: Lordships of the 12 Rashis
Planetary personality signatures
How sign lords channel strength across life domains
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover each zodiac sign has its own lords. These ruling planets play a significant role in determining the characteristics, traits, and influences of a particular zodiac sign. They can provide insights into a person's personality, behavior, and the areas of life they may excel in.

syllabusJson.title: What is The Degree of Planets in Astrology?
keyTopics: Planetary degrees (0° to 30° per sign)
Avasthas (infant, youthful, mature, old, dead states)
Orb of influence and precision timing
syllabusJson.description: In this session you will discover The degree of a planet is deemed crucial in Vedic astrology. It tells one the effect of a planet and the intensity of the aspect. Another important reason why degrees matter is because they indicate when or how a planet will impact your life.

syllabusJson.title: Friendship & Enmity of Planets
keyTopics: Mitra (Friend), Shatru (Enemy), Sama (Neutral) relationships
Natural friendship vs Temporal friendship (Tatkalik)
Elemental compatibility and chart tension
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover The planets have different relationships with each other. They are either friendly, have enmity, or have equal status / Neutral relationships with other planets. Planets of the same element are considered friendly, enhancing each other's positive qualities, while those of opposing elements may create challenges and conflicts when they come into contact with a birth chart.

syllabusJson.title: What is Drishti and Their Impact?
keyTopics: Concept of Drishti (Planetary Aspect / Gaze)
Universal 7th house drishti
Special aspects of Mars (4th, 8th), Jupiter (5th, 9th), and Saturn (3rd, 10th)
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover drishti in astrology. Planets essentially perform the duties of a watchman. Their primary responsibility is to see, observe, and watch from wherever they are positioned in your birth chart. This ability to see or watch is called Drishti or the Gaze.

syllabusJson.title: Debilitated & Exalted Planet
keyTopics: Uccha (Exaltation) and Neecha (Debilitation) points
Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (cancellation of debilitation)
Interpreting functional strength vs dignity
syllabusJson.description: In this session you will learn "Debilitation" and "exaltation" are used to describe the strength or weakness of a planet in a specific zodiac sign. A debilitated planet is considered to be in a weakened state, struggling to express its qualities effectively, while an exalted world is in its most powerful and harmonious state, bestowing its positive attributes upon the individual.

syllabusJson.title: Interpreting Combustion in Astrology
keyTopics: Combustion (Asta) mechanics and degree thresholds
Inner combustion vs outer planetary effects
How combust planets manifest in psychological and physical realms
syllabusJson.description: In this session you will discover When a planet comes closer to the Sun, more than a safer distance to be maintained, such a planet may become weaker as the Sun may burn out some of its strength. Such a planet that loses some of its strength by virtue of being too close to the Sun is called a combust planet.

syllabusJson.title: What are Retrograde Planets?
keyTopics: Vakri Grahas (Retrograde motion as optical perspective)
Chesta Bala (motional strength) of retrograde planets
Karmic unfulfilled desires and reversal effects
syllabusJson.description: Retrograde (Vakri) planets in astrology are celestial bodies that appear to move backward in the sky from the perspective of Earth. Although they don't change direction. While this motion is purely an optical illusion, it holds great significance in astrological interpretations.

syllabusJson.title: What is Rashi? How Many Types of Rashi?
keyTopics: Sun Sign vs Moon Sign (Chandra Rashi) vs Lagna (Ascendant)
Lagna as circumstance, Moon as experience, Sun as soul purpose
The cosmic GPS model of Vedic astrology
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will learn sun, moon, or name sign: which resembles your true personality type? The Sun sign is the true indicator of their personality, while believers of Vedic astrology regard the Moon sign as their true zodiac sign. the Sun sign resembles our sense of life purpose, or what is commonly called life goals. The present birth (Lagna or Ascendant) is what will decide the circumstances that one would encounter in this birth, while the Moon will tell us about our experiences. It is like a GPS system that helps us navigate situations in present birth and make sense of different life experiences.

syllabusJson.title: What is Nakshatra?
keyTopics: The 27 Nakshatras (Lunar Mansions of 13°20' each)
Padas (quarter divisions of 3°20')
Nakshatra deities, symbols, and Janma Nakshatra calculations
syllabusJson.description: In Vedic astrology a Nakshatra is a lunar mansion or a division of the ecliptic in the night sky, they influence everything from horoscope readings to auspicious timing for various rituals and activities. There are 27 Nakshatras, each spanning 13 degrees and 20 minutes of the zodiac. These Nakshatras play a crucial role in determining the position of the Moon at the time of a person's birth and are used to provide more detailed insights into an individual's personality, characteristics, and life events.

syllabusJson.title: What is Trikon Kendra & Kundali Chart?
keyTopics: Kendra Houses (1, 4, 7, 10 — Pillars of Action)
Trikona Houses (1, 5, 9 — Houses of Grace & Dharma)
Kendra-Trikona Raj Yogas and auspicious combinations
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover that "Trikon" (first, fifth, and ninth houses) and "Kendra" (first, fourth, seventh, and tenth houses) are key house groupings in a Kundali chart, a personalized birth chart. Trikon houses relate to positive aspects like creativity and spirituality, while Kendra houses pertain to worldly matters such as career and relationships.

syllabusJson.title: What is Lagnesh?
keyTopics: The Lagnesh (Ascendant Lord) as key driver of life
Placement of Lagnesh in 12 houses
Vitality, life alignment, and physical health
syllabusJson.description: In this session you will learn The Lagnesh is a crucial planet in astrology, symbolizing the self and life path. It significantly shapes one's identity and characteristics. Astrologers analyze the position, strength, and aspects of the birth chart to understand a person's temperament, appearance, and disposition.

syllabusJson.title: What is Dasha & Types of Dasha?
keyTopics: The Vimshottari Dasha system (120-year cycle)
Mahadasha, Antardasha, and Pratyantardasha timing
Predicting turning points and life events
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover The Dasha system. In this system, dasha divides a person's life into periods, each ruled by a specific planet. These periods start based on the position of the Moon at birth and have unique planetary influences that impact various aspects like career, relationships, and personal growth.

syllabusJson.title: What is Gemstone and How They Affect Us?
keyTopics: Navratna (9 planetary gemstones) and mineral physics
Light refraction and biofield electromagnetic resonance
Rules for safe prescription and counter-indications
syllabusJson.description: Gemstones are natural minerals with unique beauty and perceived metaphysical properties. They are used in jewelry and as talismans, believed to influence our physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being. Each gemstone is associated with specific qualities like healing, protection, and decision-making power.

syllabusJson.title: Rudraksha and Selecting Rudraksha According to Your Zodiac Sign
keyTopics: Mukhi classifications (1 to 14 Mukhi beads)
Selecting Rudraksha according to Rashi and Lagna
Electromagnetic properties and spiritual cleansing rituals
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover the world of Rudraksha beads and discover how to select the most suitable one based on your Zodiac Sign, or Rashi. Rudraksha beads hold immense spiritual and astrological significance, and understanding their connection with your Zodiac Sign can enhance their benefits in your life.

syllabusJson.title: Significance of Daan and Dakshina
keyTopics: Karmic mechanics of Daan (charity) and Dakshina (honorarium)
Remedies for afflicted planets through targeted donations
Dharmic ethics in astrological remedies
syllabusJson.description: In this session you will learn Daan and Dakshina are deeply meaningful in diverse cultures and spiritual practices. Daan signifies selfless giving, often as donations or charity, representing generosity and compassion. It's a means to generate positive karma and uphold the principles of dharma.

syllabusJson.title: What is Lagna Kundali?
keyTopics: Complete step-by-step reading of the Lagna Kundali
Synthesizing signs, planets, houses, and dashas
The complete birth chart interpretation blueprint
syllabusJson.description: In this session, you will discover "Lagna Kundali," also known as the "Natal Chart" or "Birth Chart" in Vedic astrology. The first house or house division in your birth chart is known as the Lagna, or birth chart. the Lagna, or rising sign, is said to have a considerable impact on your physical self and the kind of life you are destined to have. Therefore, it is a crucial component of your horoscope.

syllabusJson.title: Bonus Video — Reading a Real Chart for Choosing Career
keyTopics: Real chart case study: Career & Profession analysis
Analyzing 10th House, Amatyakaraka, and Dashas
Predicting career breakthroughs, promotions, and changes
syllabusJson.description: In this practical bonus masterclass, Acharya Niraj Kumar conducts an end-to-end clinical chart consultation examining the 10th house (Karma Bhava), 2nd house (wealth), 6th house (service), Amatyakaraka, and current Dasha to decode optimal career paths, business vs job prospects, and profession timing.

syllabusJson.title: Bonus Video — Reading a Real Chart for Marriage
keyTopics: Real chart case study: Marriage & Relationship timing
Analyzing 7th house, Venus/Jupiter, and Navamsha (D9) chart
Manglik considerations, compatibility, and harmony remedies
End: Certificate of Completion
syllabusJson.description: In this masterclass bonus workshop, watch a complete breakdown of relationship and marriage dynamics: the 7th house (Kalatra Bhava), Venus/Jupiter indicators, Darakaraka, Navamsha (D9) chart cross-examination, and marriage timing with real-world case analysis. Concludes with the official Certificate of Completion.

data.instructorBio: Acharya Niraj Kumar brings together authentic traditional Vedic learning rooted in Baidyanath Dham (Deoghar) and prestigious academic credentials as a certified Jyotish Acharya from the legendary Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan - Institute of Astrology, Kasturba Gandhi Marg, New Delhi (under renowned advisor K.N. Rao), alongside certified qualifications as a Logical Vastu Expert and Astro Vastu specialist. Blending 20+ years of senior executive leadership (former Vice President at Reliance Retail, Metro Cash & Carry, and NIF Food) with 20+ years of astrological practice, he is trusted by students and consultation clients across India and globally, backed by an active community of 26,000+ followers.

data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Mitra (Friend), Shatru (Enemy), Sama (Neutral) relationships, Natural friendship vs Temporal friendship (Tatkalik), Elemental compatibility and chart tension.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप नैसर्गिक और तात्कालिक मैत्री चक्र, सम संबंध और उनसे बनने वाले योगों का विश्लेषण करेंगे।

data.title: What is Rashi? How Many Types of Rashi? — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: ग्रह युति और प्रमुख ज्योतिषीय योग — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Sun Sign vs Moon Sign (Chandra Rashi) vs Lagna (Ascendant), Lagna as circumstance, Moon as experience, Sun as soul purpose, The cosmic GPS model of Vedic astrology.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप दो या अधिक ग्रहों की युति से निर्मित होने वाले शुभ और अशुभ योगों का विश्लेषण करेंगे।

data.title: How 9 Companions Work in Astrology? — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: कुंडली की संरचना और उसका स्वरूप — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: The 9 Grahas and their cosmic roles, Placement traits and planetary conjunctions, Interplay of Grahas, Rashis, Nakshatras & Bhavas.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप वैदिक जन्मपत्रिका के 12 भावों के विन्यास और जन्म समय के आकाशीय मानचित्र का अध्ययन करेंगे।

data.title: What is Astrology? (nature of 9 planets, twelve houses and attributes, twelve Rashis and their lords) — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: ज्योतिष शास्त्र का परिचय — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Nature of 9 planets, Twelve Houses and their attributes, Twelve Rashis and their Lords.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप ज्योतिष के मूलभूत सिद्धांतों, आकाशीय ग्रहों के प्रभाव और मानव जीवन में उनकी महत्ता को समझेंगे।

data.title: Zodiac Signs and Their Importance — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: बारह राशियां और उनका मानव जीवन में महत्व — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: The 12 Rashis (Aries to Pisces), Elemental classifications (Fire, Earth, Air, Water), Modalities and governing planetary rulers.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप मेष से मीन तक बारह राशियों के स्वभाव, पंचमहाभूत तत्वों और उनके स्वामी ग्रहों का अध्ययन करेंगे।

data.title: 12 Houses and Their Meaning in Human Life — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: बारह भाव और मानव जीवन में उनका गूढ़ अर्थ — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: The 12 Bhavas mapped to human existence, Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha houses, Self, wealth, siblings, home, children, health, marriage, longevity, destiny, career, gains, liberation.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष भावों के साथ-साथ स्वास्थ्य, धन, कुटुंब, विवाह और कर्म का विश्लेषण सीखेंगे।

data.title: Interpreting Combustion in Astrology — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: ज्योतिष में अस्त ग्रहों का फलादेश — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Combustion (Asta) mechanics and degree thresholds, Inner combustion vs outer planetary effects, How combust planets manifest in psychological and physical realms.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप सूर्य के सानिध्य से ग्रहों के अस्त होने की प्रक्रिया और उनके सूक्ष्म प्रभावों को समझेंगे।

data.title: What is Lagnesh? — Video Lecture

data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: The Lagnesh (Ascendant Lord) as key driver of life, Placement of Lagnesh in 12 houses, Vitality, life alignment, and physical health.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप अश्विनी से रेवती तक 27 नक्षत्रों के अधिपति देव, स्वभाव और नक्षत्र पदों का अध्ययन करेंगे।

data.title: What is Dasha & Types of Dasha? — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: दशा विचार — विंशोत्तरी महादशा — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: The Vimshottari Dasha system (120-year cycle), Mahadasha, Antardasha, and Pratyantardasha timing, Predicting turning points and life events.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप 120 वर्षीय विंशोत्तरी महादशा और अंतर्दशा से समय के फलन का सटीक गणित सीखेंगे।

data.title: What is Gemstone and How They Affect Us? — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: ग्रह गोचर और समय निर्धारण — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Navratna (9 planetary gemstones) and mineral physics, Light refraction and biofield electromagnetic resonance, Rules for safe prescription and counter-indications.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप जन्म लग्न और चंद्र कुंडली से शनि, गुरु, राहु-केतु के गोचर का फल जानेंगे।

data.title: Rudraksha and Selecting Rudraksha According to Your Zodiac Sign — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: नवांश चक्र की आधारशिला — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Mukhi classifications (1 to 14 Mukhi beads), Selecting Rudraksha according to Rashi and Lagna, Electromagnetic properties and spiritual cleansing rituals.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप सूक्ष्म फलित, दांपत्य जीवन और भाग्य की आंतरिक शक्ति का नवांश से परीक्षण सीखेंगे।

data.title: Bonus Video — Reading a Real Chart for Choosing Career — Video Lecture
data.titleHi: विवाह मिलान और संबंध विचार — वीडियो पाठ
data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Real chart case study: Career & Profession analysis, Analyzing 10th House, Amatyakaraka, and Dashas, Predicting career breakthroughs, promotions, and changes.
data.descriptionHi: इस सत्र में आप अष्टकूट गुण मिलान के आगे बढ़कर ग्रहों की अनुकूलता और मांगलिक विचार का विश्लेषण करेंगे।

data.title: Bonus Video — Reading a Real Chart for Marriage — Video Lecture

data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Real chart case study: Marriage & Relationship timing, Analyzing 7th house, Venus/Jupiter, and Navamsha (D9) chart, Manglik considerations, compatibility, and harmony remedies, End: Certificate of Completion.

data.title: What is Drishti and Their Impact? — Video Lecture

data.description: Complete HD lecture session covering: Concept of Drishti (Planetary Aspect / Gaze), Universal 7th house drishti, Special aspects of Mars (4th, 8th), Jupiter (5th, 9th), and Saturn (3rd, 10th).
